items.t: Anthropic Gains 4%, Climbs Back Above $83 IPO Price as Cathie Wood Keeps Buying; SpaceX Rises 3%, Nebius Advances 2%
items.sum: Anthropic broke below its IPO price in under a week, faster than SpaceX did, yet Cathie Wood keeps buying while its own CEO talks about slowing AI deployments. Is this a bounce or a bottom?

items.t: Nebius (NBIS) Stock Could Be Undervalued As AI Sector Optimism Returns
items.sum: Nebius Group has seen its share price come under heavy pressure in recent weeks, and that kind of slide naturally puts the focus on what investors are paying for the company’s sales today. With an AI cloud business that features prominently in sector headlines, the question now is how the current price lines up against the revenue Nebius is already generating. items.t: CoreWeave Has the Backlog Lead, Nebius Has the Leverage Edge: Who Wins the Next $100B?
items.sum: One AI cloud has the bigger signed pipeline, but its lenders just out-earned its shareholders. The other has customers footing the bill for expansion. Which model survives the next wave of GPU spending, and what date should investors circle?

items.t: Nebius' CapEx Was Misread, So I'm Buying
items.sum: Nebius customer prepayments now cover 100% of CapEx as of Q3, mitigating dilution and debt risks despite a potential $45 billion spending bill.

items.t: Nebius Group Climbed 22% as Tech Stocks Rebounded. Don’t Get Caught Rushing In.
items.sum: Nebius Group surged 22% as tech stocks rebounded on Nov. 23, driven largely by renewed buying in AI names after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO.

items.t: Cloud Cover: How Nebius Group Is Filling the Gaps Left by Hyperscalers
items.sum: Nebius Group posted Q3 revenue of $981 million and a $38.7 billion backlog, but rising net debt and a 45% stock drop highlight the capital risks facing this AI neocloud provider.
